## Product Growth & Platform Analytics

### Turning merchant behavior into product and investment decisions

How do you determine whether access to a platform is translating into meaningful adoption — and where intervention can create the most value?

This case study shows how I structured a global merchant measurement system around activation, time to activation, early transaction depth and later activity, then used those signals to identify and size growth opportunities.

**Demonstrates:** Product analytics · KPI strategy · Cohort analysis · Opportunity sizing · Executive decision support · SQL · Python

## Experimentation Platform

### Building reliable evidence for product decisions

How do you design experiments that support confident product decisions rather than simply report whether a metric moved?

This case study focuses on experiment design, statistical power, variance reduction, guardrails and causal interpretation in a scalable experimentation framework.

**Demonstrates:** Experiment design · A/B testing · Statistical power · CUPED · Guardrails · Causal inference · R · SQL

## Retention Risk System

### Prioritizing intervention with predictive risk and expected value

A high-performing model is not automatically a useful decision system.

This case study shows how predictive modeling can identify retention risk while incorporating calibration, intervention economics and monitoring to determine which predictions are actionable.

**Demonstrates:** Machine learning · Predictive modeling · Calibration · Expected value · Model monitoring · Decision systems · Python · SQL
